title: postfix ! is still rejected as the RIGHT operand of ??, and the reason is now the lowering's capability rather than a placement rule
notes: REWRITTEN 2026-08-30, because the rule this case used to quote no longer exists. specification/failures.mdx §Refusal Conditions withdrew the five-condition placement walk and made placement unrestricted; DECISIONS.md §Typed failures records the withdrawal. Four of the six worked examples that section lists now compile, and the corpus cases that certified their refusals were flipped in the same change. THIS ONE DID NOT FLIP, and the reason is worth stating exactly because it is no longer a fact about `??`. The right operand of `??` is CONDITIONALLY EVALUATED. The shipped lowering still spells a failure exit as an early `return`, which is a statement, so it hoists a guard to the front of the enclosing statement — and a guard hoisted out of a conditional operand runs when the authored program would not have evaluated the operand at all. Here `maybe ?? lookup("ada")!` would call `lookup` and could return its failure even when `maybe` is a string. That is a reordering, not a placement, and `conditionallyEvaluatedPosition` in poc/src/language/semantic.ts is the predicate that names it; the same predicate refuses the right operand of `&&` and `||`, either arm of a ternary, anything after a `?.`, and a `case` label expression. THE CODE IS DELIBERATELY UNCHANGED. SMITHERS1204 is kept rather than renumbered because its stated cause — 'this expression would require control-flow-aware evaluation-order rewriting' — is TRUE of this program and was only ever false of the programs that flipped. The message is rewritten to say which rewriting and why. THE REFUSAL IS NOT SCOPED TO A LOWERING OPTION: both `effectLowering` modes spell a propagation the same way today, so the refusal is uniform, and a diagnostic that fired under one option and not the other would be the per-file dialect DECISIONS.md warns against by name. It retires when the early-return lowering does, not before. Its accepted twin postfix-bang-as-a-nullish-left-operand-is-accepted is unchanged: the LEFT operand of `??` is unconditional.
